newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker, RGI merger takes effect.
newsitem.headline: Aker, RGI merger takes effect.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Aker RGI ASA came into formal being on Tuesday following completion of the merger between Aker ASA and RGI (Norway) AS.
"Shares in the Oslo-based company will be quoted on the Oslo Stock Exchange from today," a company statement said.
The merger, which was approved by shareholders in November, brought together one of Norway's oldest companies with a newcomer on the country's corporate scene.

Aker, an engineering and offshore group, was founded in 1841 while investment group RGI, which has quickly become the world's largest white-fish fishing and processing operation, was listed on the stock exchange in Oslo only last year.
Aker has said the combined company will have annual revenues of 19 billion crowns and a market capitalisation of nine billion crowns.
